narration.text: The control stopped during a tool change. I am treating this as an ATC index problem until the carousel proves otherwise.
A loose tool or chip in the pocket can stop the index. I inspect the pocket and the release path before resetting.
The next index completes cleanly. The jam was mechanical interference, not a bad control parameter.

lesson.title: An ATC index jam should be inspected mechanically before repeated resets
lesson.body: Stop cycling the changer, inspect the active pocket and release path, clear the obstruction safely, reset, and verify one complete tool change.
